explication: This repository is the source for an open textbook on computational principles of autonomous robots, not a robotics runtime. Its reader-facing result is the book; the chapters cover mathematical foundations, perception and state estimation, robot motion and planning, and learning and task execution. The README identifies book.tex as the LaTeX compilation entry point, but no source excerpts show how it references individual chapters, so chapter relationships are not drawn.
